reason: A floating 网易云音乐 player for the DeepSeek Harness Web interface, providing playback controls, music browsing, synchronized lyrics, queues, account login, and persistent browser settings.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中提供可拖拽浮窗的网易云音乐播放器，支持歌曲与歌单浏览、歌词同步、播放队列及账号登录。
summaries.en: A draggable floating NetEase Cloud Music player for the DeepSeek Harness Web interface with music browsing, synchronized lyrics, queue management, and account login.

capabilities: Plays and controls music from music.163.com
Browses songs, playlists, albums, lyrics, and translations
Uses account cookies or QR-code login for 网易云音乐 features
Stores playback queue, account state, and preferences in browser localStorage
